title: Creator Tips
description: Creators claim a handle and publish a profile; fans tip them in USDC with a message. Tips move straight from the fan to the creator, so the contract never holds funds.
prompts: Let fans tip creators in USDC with a message
Build profiles with handles where people can send tips
A Ko-fi style tip jar on Avalanche

params.name: handle
params.description: Handle for the builder's own smoke-test profile: 3 to 32 of a-z, 0-9 and _

params.name: displayName
params.description: Display name for the smoke-test profile

prerequisites: Native gas on the C-Chain for the signer
USDC for test tips, from the Circle faucet listed in the registry

contracts.name: CreatorTips
contracts.description: Handle registry, profiles, and direct USDC tips

checks.description: The builder's handle resolves to the builder

review: tip transfers from the fan to the creator directly; the contract balance stays zero.
Handles are validated on-chain (lowercase, digits, underscore); the UI applies the same rule before submitting.
Profile text is rendered as plain text and avatar URLs are loaded through an image proxy or allowlist.

frontend.summary: A creator page fans can tip in USDC, and a way for creators to claim a handle and share their page.
audience: Fans who want to support a creator
Creators who set up a page and share their link
journeys: Visit a creator: name, bio and avatar, total received and number of supporters, and recent tips with their messages.
Tip: preset amounts (1, 5, 10 USDC) or custom, an optional message, and one button such as 'Tip 5 USDC'; allowing USDC is step 1 of 2 only when needed.
After tipping: a thank-you state and the new tip at the top of the feed.
Claim a page: type a handle with a live 'available' check, add name, bio and avatar, preview the page, publish, and copy the share link.
Creators edit their profile from their own page when their wallet is connected.
flows: Route /@handle to creatorOf(handle) then profileOf(creator); show tipsReceived with 6 decimals.
Tip: approve exactly the amount on USDC, then tip(handle, amount, message).
Build the tip feed from Tipped(creator, from, amount, message) events filtered by the indexed creator.
Claim flow: check creatorOf(handle) is the zero address before calling register.
